'
Tajikistan has been and remains a strategic partner of Russia.
'
🤝
Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov
took part in an official reception
marking the 35th anniversary of the independence of the Republic of Tajikistan.
'On behalf of the leadership of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation and on my own behalf, I sincerely congratulate you on the 35th anniversary of the state independence of the Republic of Tajikistan', Andrei Belousov said.
▫️
According to him, over these years
the republic has come a long way and has become a strong and independent state
that plays an important role in ensuring stability in the Central Asian region.
'Our peoples are bound by great heroic military past and a history of military feats. For us, the Republic of Tajikistan is not just a fraternal country. Victory in the Great Patriotic War forever defined us as comrades‑in‑arms,' he said.
▫️
The Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation noted that close military cooperation has been established between Russia and Tajikistan.
The Russian military base on the territory of the republic is in a state of readiness to combat external threats.
'We highly value Tajikistan’s contribution to strengthening regional and collective security.'﻿
💬
Andrei Belousov expressed confidence that the
allied relations between Russia and Tajikistan will continue to serve as a reliable foundation for peace and security in Central Asia.
'Tajikistan has been and remains a strategic partner of Russia,' he emphasised.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.description: Online reconnaissance 💬 A Skat-350M UAV technician of the 25th Combined Arms Army of the Zapad Group of Forces shared how his work in Krasny Liman direction helps the command to see the real picture on the battlefield and make the right decisions. 'I operate Skat-350M, it's a great 'bird'. First of all, orientation on the ground. We also carry out flights, monitor aviation operations, record the strikes'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🇷🇺 Strengthening strategic partnership Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Viet
item.description: Strengthening strategic partnership 🇷🇺 🇻🇳 Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Vietnam General of Army Phan Van Giang. 💬 The Russian Defence Minister noted that the meeting is taking place as part of the State visit to Russia of Secretary General of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam To Lam. 'The contacts between the defence ministries of the two countries have become regular and make an important contribution to the development of strategic relations between Russia and Vietnam. We rely on a joint strategic partnership plan in the military sphere in our work,' said Andrei Belousov. 📆 The Russian Defence Minister also congratulated General of Army Phan Van Giang on the 81st anniversary of the independence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. In turn, General of Army Phan Van Giang thanked Andrei Belousov for the opportunity to meet: 'We know that you have a very busy working schedule, and you have allocated time for this meeting'. 📈 He noted that during the official visit of the Vietnamese delegation in May of this year, specific areas of development of bilateral military and military-technical cooperation were discussed and are currently actively being implemented. 🤝 The talks took place in a constructive manner, the sides discussed current issues of Russian-Vietnamese military and military-technical cooperat
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29281

Strengthening
strategic partnership
🇷🇺
🇻🇳
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence of Socialist Republic of Vietnam General of Army Phan Van Giang.
💬
The Russian Defence Minister noted
that the meeting is taking place as part of the State visit to Russia of Secretary General of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam To Lam.
'The contacts between the defence ministries of the two countries have become regular and make an important contribution to the development of strategic relations between Russia and Vietnam.
We rely on a joint strategic partnership plan in the military sphere in our work,' said Andrei Belousov.
📆
The Russian Defence Minister also congratulated General of Army Phan Van Giang on the 81st anniversary of the independence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
In turn, General of Army Phan Van Giang thanked Andrei Belousov for the opportunity to meet:
'We know that you have a very busy working schedule, and you have allocated time for this meeting'.
📈
He noted that during the official visit of the Vietnamese delegation in May of this year,
specific areas of development of bilateral military and military-technical cooperation were discussed
and are currently actively being implemented.
🤝
The talks took place in a constructive manner,
the sides discussed current issues of Russian-Vietnamese military and military-technical cooperation.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
